verdict.rationale: Beamer documents collecting and prioritizing feedback and offers public and private roadmaps, so this axis applies to the product. However, no evidence shows that requests can be organized into a hierarchy of features, components, or initiatives. Feedback prioritization and roadmaps are adjacent features, not the hierarchical structure the story asks for.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can organize requests into a hierarchy of features, components, and initiatives
